opening.argument: The video presents an investigation into SIREN's price events and underlying market data, beginning with the explicit statement, "So our investigation really begins on March 24th." It examines the AI narrative against material risks, including a wallet cluster that held up to 88% of circulating supply, leveraged trading, and the reported wiping out of $22 million in leveraged long positions. Its conclusion directs viewers to ask whether they are examining price or hidden data, framing the discussion as market analysis rather than a stated participation flow. The rebound is likewise described as unrelated to good news or a change in long-term value, supporting a technical market explanation rather than promotional messaging.

citations.quote: So our investigation really begins on March 24th.
when the next big story comes along you gotta ask yourself, are you just looking at the price or are you looking at the data that's hidden in the code?

The data showed that a single, interconnected cluster of wallets — and that just means a group of addresses likely controlled by one individual or the public address controlled by a group held up to 88% of Siren's circulating supply.
As the price started to dip, a reported $22 million worth of these leveraged long positions, those are bets that the price would go up, were wiped out.
This rebound had nothing to do with good news. It had nothing to do with a change in Siren's long-term value.
